requirements.title: Account record
requirements.statement: Each customer is held as one account carrying customer type, industry, country, assigned salesperson and A/B/C class; each field can filter account lists.

requirements.title: Contacts and decision makers
requirements.statement: An account holds multiple contacts; any contact can be flagged as a decision maker.

requirements.title: A/B/C classification
requirements.statement: Every account carries a mandatory class: A (critical), B (medium) or C (low); accounts and dashboards filter by class.

requirements.title: Credit terms
requirements.statement: Credit terms are visible on the account.

requirements.title: Purchase history
requirements.statement: Past purchases of the customer are visible from the account.

requirements.title: Last interaction and next follow-up
requirements.statement: The account always shows the last logged interaction and the next open follow-up with its owner and date.

requirements.title: Complete customer view
requirements.statement: Leads, opportunities, quotations, visits, follow-ups and WhatsApp conversations for a customer are reachable from the account.

requirements.title: Lead record
requirements.statement: Each potential deal is captured as a lead with an owner and a status.

requirements.title: Lead status list
requirements.statement: Lead status uses one confirmed list; an admin can add or rename statuses without code changes.

requirements.title: Qualify and convert
requirements.statement: A qualified lead converts to an account and contact in one action, keeping a link back to the original lead.

requirements.title: Opportunity on a lead or an account
requirements.statement: An opportunity can be created against an unconverted lead, or against an account.

requirements.title: Closed outcome
requirements.statement: A closed lead records its outcome as Disqualified or Converted.

requirements.title: Opportunity record
requirements.statement: Each opportunity carries its lead or account, product, value, currency, expected close date, stage, owner and country.

requirements.title: Opportunity stages
requirements.statement: Opportunity stages use one confirmed list; an admin can change stages without code changes; each stage change is recorded with date and user.

requirements.title: Visual pipeline
requirements.statement: A board view shows opportunities as cards in stage columns, with count and total value per column.

requirements.title: Next action rule
requirements.statement: No open opportunity exists without a next action, an owner and a deadline.

requirements.title: Won or lost with reason
requirements.statement: Closing an opportunity records the outcome, Won or Lost, and the reason.

requirements.title: PO receipt
requirements.statement: Receipt of the customer PO is recorded with its reference and date.

requirements.title: Pipeline view
requirements.statement: One view shows total pipeline, weighted pipeline, expected orders, actual orders and target for a selected period.

requirements.title: Slicing
requirements.statement: Every pipeline figure can be sliced by country, salesperson, product and customer.

requirements.title: Weighted pipeline
requirements.statement: Weighted pipeline is calculated on logic agreed with the Crescent Gulf business.

requirements.title: 30, 60 and 90-day expected orders
requirements.statement: Expected orders are grouped into 30, 60 and 90-day buckets.

requirements.title: Targets
requirements.statement: Sales targets are held on Neome by salesperson, product and country for a set period.

requirements.title: Actual orders
requirements.statement: Actual orders are counted from one agreed source and reconcile to it.

requirements.title: Quotation document
requirements.statement: The quotation document is prepared outside Neome and attached to a quotation record on Neome.

requirements.title: Quotation record
requirements.statement: Each quotation record holds quotation number, product, quantity, price, validity, approval status and the linked opportunity.

requirements.title: Expected PO date
requirements.statement: Expected PO date is a field on the quotation on Neome.

requirements.title: Cost and gross margin
requirements.statement: Cost and gross margin for the quotation come from Tally ERP.

requirements.title: Revision history
requirements.statement: Each revision is added as a new document on the quotation; earlier documents stay available.

requirements.title: Discount approval matrix
requirements.statement: Approval is driven by discount %: under 10% none, 10 to 20% Level 1, 20 to 25% Levels 1 and 2, over 25% Levels 1, 2 and 3; an admin can change bands and levels without code changes.

requirements.title: Quotation PDF generation
requirements.statement: Neome does not generate the quotation document or PDF (out of scope).

requirements.title: Visit log
requirements.statement: Each visit captures customer, date, participants, purpose, discussion, linked opportunity, competitor information, next action, owner and deadline.

requirements.title: Field teams
requirements.statement: Field teams log visits from phone or tablet while travelling across the Middle East, Africa and CIS.

requirements.title: Visits and resulting business
requirements.statement: A report shows how many visits happened per salesperson per week and what business (opportunities, quotations) resulted.

requirements.title: Owned follow-ups
requirements.statement: Every follow-up has an owner and a deadline.

requirements.title: Status flags
requirements.statement: Follow-ups are flagged automatically: red Overdue, orange Due today, yellow Due this week, green Completed.

requirements.title: Reminders
requirements.statement: The owner receives a reminder for each follow-up; an admin sets reminder timing.

requirements.title: Salesperson performance
requirements.statement: Per salesperson: target vs actual sales, achievement %, conversion ratio, new customers, opportunities, pipeline, weighted pipeline, visits, follow-ups, and orders won and lost.

requirements.title: Collections and outstanding
requirements.statement: Collections and outstanding amounts per salesperson are picked up from Tally ERP.

requirements.title: One-page management dashboard
requirements.statement: Sections for Sales, Pipeline, Customers, Business Development, Collections and People, plus risks: lost orders, at-risk customers, delayed deals and overdue actions; Neomenta proposes the first set.

requirements.title: Product, geography and molecule view
requirements.statement: Performance by product (oilfield, water treatment, agrochemicals), geography (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Africa, CIS, others) and molecule (DBNPA, corrosion and scale inhibitors, biocides, others).

requirements.title: Product and market intelligence
requirements.statement: Capture of buying signals and market updates that keep sales teams current; scope open.

requirements.title: Competitor database
requirements.statement: Capture competitor name, price, product, customer preference, competitive advantage and reason for winning or losing, building a competitor database; scope open.

requirements.title: Registration and tender tracker
requirements.statement: Track country, customer, product, registration and authority, with submission date, status, expected approval, tender and value; scope open.

requirements.title: WhatsApp Business
requirements.statement: Customer WhatsApp conversations become part of the shared customer history; the WhatsApp Business API is procured by Crescent Gulf or charged on actuals.

requirements.title: Calendar sync
requirements.statement: Calendar sync is delivered on Neome.

requirements.title: Email
requirements.statement: Outlook and Gmail integration is part of the ERP integration scope.

requirements.title: Mobile and tablet
requirements.statement: On phone and tablet, users update visits, add opportunities, upload quotations and notes, set next actions, check customer history and reach contacts.

requirements.title: Order-to-cash flow
requirements.statement: CRM to quotation to sales order to ERP to invoice to collection runs as one flow, scoped with the Tally partner.

requirements.title: Shared customer master
requirements.statement: One shared customer master with Tally, with no duplicate data entry.

requirements.title: Data from Tally into Neome
requirements.statement: At minimum quotation cost and gross margin, and collections and outstanding, come from Tally into Neome.

requirements.title: Roles and permissions
requirements.statement: Users are set up with roles and permissions that match Crescent Gulf's sales organisation.

requirements.title: Data migration
requirements.statement: Existing customer and pipeline data is migrated.

requirements.title: Training
requirements.statement: Training for users in each role is delivered as part of go-live and change management.

requirements.title: Post go-live support
requirements.statement: Support is given after go-live.

requirements.title: Process mapping
requirements.statement: Crescent Gulf's sales process is mapped before configuration.
